Mr. D.K. Joshi, learned counsel for

notice was issued to respondent No.4, 
but, as per office report, there is no

5. In this view of the matter, learned 
counsel for the petitioner is directed to 
take fresh steps on respondent No.4 
through Dasti mode, returnable within

22.12.2025 MCC/7502/2022 (Restoration Application)
IA/7503/2022 (Delay Condonation Applciaton in Restoration Application)
In 
WPSS No.1118 of 2008
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Mr. D.K. Joshi, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Naveen Tewari, learned Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand.
3. The notices were issued to respondent no.4 
and the petitioner was directed to take steps for 
service.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed 
an affidavit of service, which indicates that notices 
have been served on the respondent no.4 in the 
month of September, 2024.
5. There is no representation for respondent 
no.4.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner prays that 
delay in preferring the restoration application may 
be condoned.
7. For the reasons stated therein, the delay 
condonation application is allowed and the delay
in filing restoration application is condoned. 
8. The restoration application filed by the 
petitioner is allowed for the reasons stated therein 
and the file is restored to its original number.
9. List this case on 05.01.2026 for hearing.
 (Subhash Upadhyay,J.)
 22.12.2025
